attributes.alt: Crays

children: You live free. We connect the layers.

Crays is where Nostr becomes real life: private business nomads, capital, technology, hospitality, real estate, culture and community come together in one ecosystem. Nostr is the open identity and event rail underneath it, so your profile, venue context, reputation, content, payments and future governance can travel with you instead of staying trapped in one platform.
Nostr public keys, profiles and signatures give Crays a portable social foundation.
Clubs, hotels, coffee shops, resorts and events can carry local context without becoming closed silos.
Finance, real estate and hospitality are tied to demand, community, operating data and visible projects.
Awards, creators, lifestyle moments and member experiences make the ecosystem human.
One ecosystem. Eight layers that work for you.

You are not stepping into one app, one club or one finance story. You are stepping into a coordinated stack of independent projects and operating partners. Each layer has its job. Together they create a network you can live in, work in and build on.
Your Nostr identity, keys and signatures move across Crays places and products.
Hotels, clubs, rooftops and resorts can become local nodes in the network.
Crays Circle, Crays.net and daily tools turn the network into something you can use.
Real assets, digital value and investor structures are tied to long-term use.
Independent vehicles can carry real products, brand rights and clear ownership.
Members, creators, music, art and moments give the network its soul.
Rules, councils, badges and reputation keep the network clean and verifiable.
Nostr, relays, mesh, Lightning and Super Nodes power the everyday layer.

children: Crays is building toward a network that people can live in, work in and move through.

The internal vision material points toward 2035 with a bold idea: a Bitcoin-native lifestyle infrastructure where members, venues, creators, operators, assets and local networks reinforce each other. The numbers are vision targets, but the direction is clear: physical places and open digital rails belong together.
Crays Circle, app thinking, Nostr identity and public ecosystem pages become the visible foundation.
Super Nodes, creator badges, content access and local venue experiments turn the protocol layer into operations.
Hospitality, real estate, app usage, creators and venue partners can make Crays feel present across cities and destinations.
The vision moves toward tokenized assets, ecosystem value flows, trade finance concepts and broader brand licensing.
The ambition is a global web of Crays Clubs, Super Nodes, registered users, venues and real-world lifestyle infrastructure.
Whatever grows, the principle stays: open identity, signed events and portable social context before closed-platform gravity.

children: Who belongs in the next chapter
We are looking for people who can make the ecosystem more real.

The invitation is selective because the work is practical. We need people who bring trust, execution, capital, taste, technical depth, venue access, community energy or the courage to build something global without making it generic.
Entrepreneurs, investors, creators, operators and executives who want a serious private network with real-world gravity.
Hotels, clubs, resorts, rooftops, coffee concepts and event spaces that can become local Crays nodes.
Investors and finance partners who understand that access, demand, brand and assets can belong together.
Nostr, Lightning, mesh, AI, data, product and security builders who can turn the vision into reliable systems.
People who make music, fashion, film, media, art, architecture and events feel alive inside the network.
Specialists in legal, finance, real estate, hospitality, tokenization, governance, risk, venues and international expansion.

children: Read Crays as a stack you can actually walk through.

The cleanest way to understand us is not to memorize every domain. Follow the job each layer does. The association keeps the brand and project logic legible. The app turns identity into action. Venues make the network physical. Finance gives selected projects a capital route. Coffee, clubs, awards and island hospitality give the idea everyday and cultural proof points.
Crays.org is the front door and governance spine.

You get the public spine here: Swiss non-profit association, tokenized-brand thesis, member groups, council or DAO-style governance and project doors for hospitality, fund, world, club, coffee and award.
Crays.net and Circle are the product surface.
Use this door when you want Nostr identity to stop being theory: profile, venue context, discovery, messages, access, creator activity, wallet-ready actions and member status in one daily flow.
Crays World makes the room part of the network.
Open this when you want the room-level stack: Super Node, local relay, mesh, Lightning-native POS, ordering, booking and community discovery.
The Fund and Life pages move from attention to assets.

Follow this route when capital becomes concrete: luxury short-term-rental workflows, investor onboarding and the Mercedes Island case with a 64-hectare place, hospitality rails and a proof point to inspect.
Clubs, Coffee and Award give the network rhythm.
Use Club for the work-live-play room, Coffee for the repeat ritual and Award for the creator and fan engine. Together they show why infrastructure needs culture people want to return to.
Nostr is the portability rail, not the decoration.

Public keys, NIP-05 names, signer login, relays, zaps, Nostr Wallet Connect, badges and signed events are useful only when they help you carry identity, trust and value across Crays places without losing control.
